issues.problem:
A hidden part changes the mass and balance shown. This is a regression against f7ac37d that came in with round 2 and is still in round 3. It sits in the measure's ties, not the verdict's.

How it happens: acrossTies (l.503-524) places every part across from the centre of the parts it ties with on volume, height and kept flag (kept[q.index] == kept[p.index]). A cleaned part is therefore placed from the centre of the CLEANED parts it ties with. MassProps.ownership then gives an overlap between two cleaned parts to whichever ranks first in Sampling.measureRanked. So a third hidden part tied with them moves that centre and decides who owns the overlap.
